recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-7514 unless Pharmacy later changes the shared CodeableReference medication pattern.
issue_request: FHIR-7514 was a Published Pharmacy change request, resolved as Persuasive with Modification and recorded as a duplicate of FHIR-7473. It asked for MedicationStatement to allow a coded medication rather than only Reference(Medication), with the duplicate-family resolution saying the medication resources should support either a code or the full Medication resource.
initial_application: No current source commit message was found that explicitly mentions FHIR-7514 or FHIR-7473. Jira comments from 2015 say this was one of several duplicate medication-code requests and that the change had already been done; git history shows 2015 medication spreadsheet work adding MedicationStatement.medicationCodeableConcept/code search support around the prior medicationReference handling.
additional_context: The duplicate target FHIR-7473 is already represented on the combined branch by audit commit 3bb167aa0c53739e7a7d6c7a2953645f27a73857, so no duplicate FHIR-7473 decision was published. MedicationStatement is active in source/fhir.ini, and current MedicationStatement.medication is CodeableReference(Medication), with definition/comment text and examples covering both medication concepts/codes and referenced Medication resources.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already conveys the requested coded-medication alternative in the current R6 representation, so no source edit was needed.
